_about: Name Reveal (Top-100 #4, r19 snippco, score 9), v2 7 Oct 2026, matched frame by frame: a BLACK-AND-WHITE world with the speaker in COLOUR the whole reel (ground backdrop grayscale over every speaker stretch, the cut-out on top), a light-leak open, the NAME huge in bold white sans at head height partly hidden by the head, small bold white sans lead lines with ONE glowing orange serif-italic word, black word cards with a small sans word then a serif-italic word that blurs out. Sound like the ref (demucs 7 Oct): no music bed, bright 3-5 kHz whooshes on the words and the cuts (~90 hits/min in the ref).

director.style: Name Reveal: a black-and-white world with the speaker in colour, a light-leak open, the name huge behind the head, small bold sans lines with one glowing orange serif-italic word, black serif word cards. Cinematic, personal, premium.
director.ground: Cover EVERY speaker stretch (everything that is not a card) with ground beats backdrop 'grayscale(1) contrast(1.15)' and sfx none: the room goes black and white, the cut-out speaker stays in colour. Back to back, no gaps.
director.opening: leak 0-0.4 s; a behind beat with the NAME (or identity word) in caps, color #FFFFFF, from the word it is spoken to the end of the sentence. Keep the name out of captions.heroes. On a close or mid shot set the behind word at eye level (y about the forehead, e.g. 330) and size 240-280 so the letters show either side of the head.
director.captions: captions.heroes: one content word per phrase; captions.serif: ALL heroes (white serif italic). captions.glowWords: the ONE or TWO payoff words of the reel (the product, the result) that glow orange, like 'Shopee'. Small lead words lowercase bold sans.
director.wordcards: 1-2 black wordpage cards on a question or contrast word: serif: [the word], inSfx whoosh-2, in cut, out blur.
director.sound: No music (music false). Bright whooshes: captions heroSfx whoosh-1 every >= 0.6 s, whoosh-2 on cards; nothing on the ground beats.
